description: Block agent HTTP POST/PUT with body via curl or wget. Prompt injection through customer input frequently uses this pattern to exfiltrate credentials or PII to attacker-controlled hosts.
message: Blocked: agent HTTP POST with body detected. Prompt injection through customer input frequently uses curl/wget POST to exfiltrate credentials or PII. Route legitimate outbound calls through an approved integration.

enforcement.guarantee: Blocks HTTP POST/PUT with body only on hook + runtime surfaces when tool_input contains matching command bytes.
requires: Pre-tool hook installed for the calling AI tool, OR conduct runtime evaluation active for brain block tool_use
known_limitations: Does not cover raw socket writes or python http.client / requests library calls
